name: serine and arginine rich splicing factor 2

function.text: SRSF2 encodes a serine/arginine-rich RNA-binding splicing factor that regulates splice-site selection and processing of pre-mRNA.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic SRSF2 mutations occur in myelodysplastic and myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasms. Disease classification requires the accompanying clinical, morphologic, and molecular findings.
